baseline_scope: Scheduler context-owner wake, cumulative receive window and Arc socket registry fixes already enabled; virtio TX still synchronous; control packets still allocated.
final_scope: Additionally async pooled virtio TX, configuration IRQ carrier caching, device notification suppression and small-control-packet allocation reductions. Application-write serialization no longer masks interrupts across the whole payload; startup carrier is sampled after pending config interrupt acknowledgement.
interpretation: Virtio improves consistently. USB-NCM was unimproved before the TCP outer IRQ guard change; quiet frozen-image A/B/A rechecks show a modest NCM improvement afterward. USB-NCM TX remains about 376 Mbps. No physical Switch throughput or 1-Gbps/backend-ceiling claim.
